cross_check_movement_optimizer.model_difference_explanation: Movement Optimizer is a planar rigid-body estimate (gravity and torso inertia, no muscles); OpenSim is a 3D JointReaction with no trunk muscles. Rotated into the torso frame with matched m_above (136.50 kg), the residual is 402.90 N compression (max |594.78| N) and -665.31 N AP shear (max |993.70| N) against the 50.0 N tolerance. The residual is not yet decomposed into its sources (pelvis acceleration, 3D coupling, contact).
